Welcome to the **Isogeny-based Cryptography Wiki**. This site serves as an open-source, mathematically rigorous, and accessible repository of knowledge detailing post-quantum cryptographic protocols built on the hardness of finding isogenies between elliptic curves.

---

## Getting Started

If you are not familiar with the concept of cryptographic protocols, we recommend referring to the [notes by Dan Boneh and Victor Shoup](https://toc.cryptobook.us/).

This wiki aims to cover all peer-reviewed isogeny-based key exchange schemes and digital signature schemes.

## Contributing

This wiki is maintained by the **isogeny-crypto** organization. If you spot a mathematical error, want to expand on a protocol's performance metrics, or wish to add a new primitive:

1. Fork the repository on [GitHub](https://github.com/isogeny-crypto/isogeny-crypto.github.io).
2. Create your article using a `.qmd` file in the `protocols/` directory.
3. Submit a Pull Request.
